attempted_claim: Let R be a full Suslin tree, A an Aronszajn tree such that no derived tree R' in ∂R club-embeds into A, η a ladder system on ω1, and h a constant 2-colouring of η. Does there exist a proper forcing Q such that Q forces that R is full Suslin and Q forces that there is an A-uniformization of h? In particular, does Moore's uniformization forcing from [Moore, Michigan Math. J. 55 (2007)] have this property under the stated non-embeddability hypothesis?
decisive_failure: Full-text acquisition of Moore 2007 (DOI 10.1307/mmj/1187647002) was unavailable, so the 'in particular Moore forcing' clause could only be assessed via Soukup's published discussion of it; no new preservation theorem, counterexample, or alternative uniformization forcing was established, and the verdict is scoped to the unconditional target as stated within a bounded session.
